approval.title: OC PHASE 4 — OWNER APPROVES DIRECT EGG TELEPORT TEST
approval.source: Direct explicit human owner message in the current Codex conversation.
approval.quote: I explicitly authorize a narrowly scoped direct-positioning experiment on my own Roblox account.
approval.scope: False-by-default OWNER_DIRECT_EGG_TELEPORT_TEST; only account 10864747620, exact verified loaded physical Common Egg Instance in The Overworld, one direct physical Root CFrame setter, no retries. This isolated experiment bypasses standing search, footprint and clearance only; native identity, access, account, cancellation, lease, scheduler and presentation checks remain.
approval.sourceChanges: One commented Config flag, three-line Execute diagnostic dispatch and one separate appended mechanics diagnostic; existing ResolveStanding and PositionSelectedEgg are byte-for-byte frozen.
approval.exclusions: No hatching, equipment, spending, purchases, pickups, farming, bubbles, native transitions, automatic retries, snap-back, walking, ordinary movement changes or competing scheduler.
approval.uncertainty: Overlap, falling, Roblox physics and external corrections are accepted experiment risks, not guaranteed behavior. Arrival and native interaction range require actual observation; the existing physical diagnostic radius alone is not proof of native eligibility.

patch.provenance: Exact implemented source delta recorded after the direct behavioral approval; not an earlier owner-reviewed hash.

diff --git a/src/OCFoundation/EggTravelManager.luau b/src/OCFoundation/EggTravelManager.luau
index f3267f1..82cb6be 100644
--- a/src/OCFoundation/EggTravelManager.luau
+++ b/src/OCFoundation/EggTravelManager.luau
@@ -634,6 +634,9 @@ end
 
 function EggTravelManager:Execute(record, token)
 	local settings, c = self:Settings(), self.Controller
+	if settings.OWNER_DIRECT_EGG_TELEPORT_TEST then
+		return c.Farming.Mechanics:ExecuteOwnerDirectEggTeleportTest(self, record, token)
+	end
 	local fresh, reason = self:Validate(record, token)
 	if not fresh then self:Release(reason, true) return { Verified = false, Reason = reason } end
 	local lease = self.Lease
diff --git a/src/OCFoundation/GameMechanics.luau b/src/OCFoundation/GameMechanics.luau
index adb7443..5102e19 100644
--- a/src/OCFoundation/GameMechanics.luau
+++ b/src/OCFoundation/GameMechanics.luau
@@ -1066,4 +1066,116 @@ function GameMechanics:ReleaseAntiAFKInput()
 	return false, tostring(reason)
 end
 
+-- Explicit owner diagnostic only. Ordinary standing/positioning methods above stay frozen.
+function GameMechanics:ExecuteOwnerDirectEggTeleportTest(manager, record, token)
+	local c, settings = self.LocalFeatureController, self.Config.EGG_TRAVEL_SETTINGS
+	local active = c and c.Scheduler and c.Scheduler.Active
+	local assigned, requestedPosition, beforePosition, last, nativeReason, nativeRange, maxDisplacement = false, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, 0
+	local function scope()
+		if not c or manager ~= c.EggTravel or c.State ~= "RUNNING" or not token or token:CheckCancelled()
+			or not active or c.Scheduler.Active ~= active or active.Token ~= token
+			or active.Definition.Owner ~= "EGG_TRAVEL" or active.Definition.Generation ~= c.Generation
+			or manager.Lease ~= record or record.Generation ~= c.Generation or manager.DiagnosticConsumed ~= true
+			or manager.DiagnosticEnded then return "Owner direct test cancelled or scheduler/lease changed" end
+		if self.Player ~= c.Reader.Player or not self.Player or self.Player.UserId ~= 10864747620
+			or manager.BrainUserId ~= 10864747620 then return "Owner direct test requires account 10864747620" end
+		local intent, hatch, allowance = manager.BrainIntent, self.Config.HATCH_SETTINGS, self.Config.OWNER_ONE_HATCH_TEST_SETTINGS
+		if self.Config ~= c.Config or settings ~= c.Config.EGG_TRAVEL_SETTINGS or settings.OWNER_DIRECT_EGG_TELEPORT_TEST ~= true
+			or settings.MODE ~= "TRAVEL_ONLY" or not settings.ENABLE_SELECTED_EGG_TRAVEL or not settings.ENABLE_DIRECT_POSITIONING
+			or settings.ENABLE_NATIVE_ISLAND_TRAVEL or settings.MAXIMUM_ATTEMPTS_PER_SELECTION ~= 1
+			or hatch.EGG_SELECTION_MODE ~= "MANUAL" or #hatch.SELECTED_EGGS ~= 1 or hatch.SELECTED_EGGS[1] ~= "Common Egg"
+			or not intent or intent.Scope ~= "TRAVEL_ONLY" or intent.DecisionSource ~= "BRAIN_TRAVEL_DIAGNOSTIC"
+			or intent.EggName ~= "Common Egg" or intent.Model ~= record.Model or intent.World ~= "The Overworld"
+			or record.EggName ~= "Common Egg" or record.World ~= "The Overworld" or record.LocationOnly ~= true
+			or allowance.OWNER_ONE_COMMON_EGG_FUNCTIONAL_TEST or allowance.OWNER_ONE_HATCH_TEST_ALLOWANCE
+			or allowance.AUTHORIZED_ACCOUNT_ID ~= 0 or allowance.MAXIMUM_COIN_ALLOWANCE ~= 0 or allowance.MAXIMUM_EGG_COST ~= 0
+			or self.Config.UPGRADE_SETTINGS.MAXIMUM_PURCHASE_COST ~= 0 then return "Owner direct test scope/actions/budgets changed" end
+		return c.Brain:TravelDiagnosticBlocker()
+	end
+	local function finish(arrived, interaction, reason)
+		manager.LastResult = { Status = arrived and (interaction and "OWNER_DIRECT_NATIVE_ARRIVAL_OBSERVED" or "OWNER_DIRECT_PHYSICAL_ARRIVAL_OBSERVED")
+			or "OWNER_DIRECT_ARRIVAL_UNCONFIRMED", Scope = "TRAVEL_ONLY", EggName = "Common Egg", IdentityId = record.IdentityId,
+			World = record.World, PhysicalArrivalVerified = arrived, InteractionVerified = interaction == true,
+			PhysicalPolicyInRange = last and last.Distance <= last.Range or false, Distance = last and last.Distance,
+			NativeRange = nativeRange, InteractionReason = nativeReason, DirectPositionAttempted = assigned,
+			NativeTravelAttempted = false, HatchCommands = 0, EquipmentCommands = 0, Spending = 0,
+			RequestedPosition = requestedPosition, ObservedDisplacement = last and requestedPosition and (last.CharacterRoot.Position - requestedPosition).Magnitude,
+			MaximumObservedDisplacement = maxDisplacement, MovementObserved = last and beforePosition and (last.CharacterRoot.Position - beforePosition).Magnitude > 0.5,
+			Reason = reason }
+		manager.DiagnosticEnded, manager.Lease = true, nil
+		manager.Reason = not interaction and reason or nil
+		if not arrived then manager.Blocked[record.SelectionKey] = reason end
+		manager:DiagnosticTrace("OWNER_DIRECT_RESULT", last or record, reason)
+		return { Verified = arrived, Reason = reason, InteractionVerified = interaction == true }
+	end
+	local blocker = scope()
+	if blocker then return finish(false, false, blocker) end
+	if self.OwnerDirectEggTeleportConsumed then return finish(false, false, "Owner direct test assignment already consumed; no retry") end
+	manager:DiagnosticTrace("OWNER_DIRECT_EXCEPTION", record, "Explicit owner test: standing search, footprint and clearance bypassed; Root overlap/fall/correction possible; no hatch/spending")
+	local allowed, guardReason = self:LocalFeatureGuard()
+	if not allowed then return finish(false, false, guardReason or "Native presentation guard unavailable") end
+	local fresh, reason = manager:Validate(record, token, true)
+	if not fresh then return finish(false, false, reason) end
+	last = fresh
+	blocker = scope()
+	if blocker then return finish(false, false, blocker) end
+	if fresh.Model ~= record.Model or fresh.TargetRoot ~= record.TargetRoot or fresh.CharacterRoot ~= record.CharacterRoot
+		or fresh.LocationVerified ~= true or fresh.World ~= "The Overworld" or fresh.CurrentWorld ~= "The Overworld"
+		or fresh.NeedsNativeTravel or not fresh.TargetRoot.Parent or not fresh.TargetRoot:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
+		or fresh.Model:FindFirstChild("Root") ~= fresh.TargetRoot then return finish(false, false, "Exact loaded Common Egg/character/world/access changed") end
+	local position = fresh.TargetRoot.Position
+	if not featureFinite(position.X) or not featureFinite(position.Y) or not featureFinite(position.Z) then return finish(false, false, "Selected Root position unavailable") end
+	local directFrame = CFrame.new(position) -- Exactly the observed physical Root; no standing/clearance substitution.
+	blocker = scope()
+	if blocker then return finish(false, false, blocker) end
+	self.OwnerDirectEggTeleportConsumed = true -- Consume before setter, including uncertain errors; never repeat.
+	manager.Attempts[record.SelectionKey] = (manager.Attempts[record.SelectionKey] or 0) + 1
+	record.Status, record.DirectPositionAttempted = "TRAVELING", true
+	assigned, requestedPosition, beforePosition = true, position, fresh.CharacterRoot.Position
+	local ok, err = pcall(function() fresh.CharacterRoot.CFrame = directFrame end)
+	manager:DiagnosticTrace("OWNER_DIRECT_POSITION_ATTEMPTED", fresh, "One owner-authorized physical Root CFrame setter attempted; standing/clearance intentionally bypassed; arrival not yet verified")
+	if not ok then return finish(false, false, "Owner direct assignment failed/uncertain; no retry: " .. tostring(err)) end
+	local deadline = math.min(record.Deadline, os.clock() + math.min(12, settings.ARRIVAL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS))
+	local stableAt, stablePosition, nativeVerified
+	while os.clock() < deadline do
+		fresh, reason = manager:Validate(record, token)
+		if not fresh then return finish(false, false, reason) end
+		local observed = fresh.CharacterRoot.Position
+		local final, finalReason = manager:Validate(record, token, true)
+		if not final then return finish(false, false, finalReason) end
+		last, blocker = final, scope()
+		if blocker then return finish(false, false, blocker) end
+		if final.Model ~= record.Model or final.TargetRoot ~= record.TargetRoot or final.CharacterRoot ~= record.CharacterRoot
+			or final.LocationVerified ~= true or final.World ~= "The Overworld" or final.CurrentWorld ~= "The Overworld" then
+			return finish(false, false, "Selected physical egg/character/world changed during owner direct observation")
+		end
+		local interaction, why, native = manager:HatchInteractionAt(final, final.CharacterRoot.Position, true) -- Read-only exact registration evidence.
+		local actual = final.CharacterRoot.Position
+		local rangeOK, rangeReason = false, nil
+		if interaction == true and native and native.Model == record.Model and native.TargetRoot == record.TargetRoot then
+			rangeOK, rangeReason = manager:RangeEligibleAt(native, actual, true) -- Preserve native prompt/nearest rules.
+		end
+		blocker = scope()
+		if blocker then return finish(false, false, blocker) end
+		actual = final.CharacterRoot.Position -- Delegated native observations may yield; use the position after them.
+		nativeVerified = rangeOK == true and native and native.RangeOrigin and native.RangeOrigin.Parent
+			and (actual - native.RangeOrigin.Position).Magnitude <= native.Range
+		local displacement = (actual - requestedPosition).Magnitude
+		maxDisplacement = math.max(maxDisplacement, displacement)
+		nativeReason, nativeRange = rangeReason or why, native and native.Range
+		final.Distance = (actual - final.RangeOrigin.Position).Magnitude
+		local nearby = final.Distance <= final.Range or nativeVerified
+		if nearby and (actual - observed).Magnitude <= 0.35 and (not stablePosition or (actual - stablePosition).Magnitude <= 0.35) then
+			stableAt, stablePosition = stableAt or os.clock(), stablePosition or actual
+			if os.clock() - stableAt >= settings.STABILITY_SECONDS then
+				return finish(true, nativeVerified, string.format("Stable actual arrival observed; native interaction=%s (%s); Root displacement=%.2f studs, maximum=%.2f; cause UNKNOWN (physics/external correction possible); one assignment; zero hatch/equipment/spending",
+					tostring(nativeVerified == true), tostring(nativeReason), displacement, maxDisplacement))
+			end
+		else stableAt, stablePosition = nil, nil end
+		task.wait(0.2)
+	end
+	return finish(false, false, string.format("Owner direct arrival unconfirmed; native interaction=%s (%s); maximum observed Root displacement=%.2f studs; cause UNKNOWN; no retry",
+		tostring(nativeVerified == true), tostring(nativeReason), maxDisplacement))
+end
+
 return GameMechanics

function EggTravelManager:ResolveStanding(record)
	local ok, frameOrReason = pcall(function()
		local root, humanoid, target = record.CharacterRoot, record.Humanoid, record.RangeOrigin
		if not live(target) or not vector(root.Size) or not finite(humanoid.HipHeight) or humanoid.HipHeight < 0 then
			return "Avatar/target geometry unavailable"
		end
		if type(workspace.Raycast) ~= "function" or type(workspace.GetPartBoundsInBox) ~= "function"
			or not RaycastParams or not OverlapParams or not CFrame then return "Standing-surface or clearance runtime unavailable" end
		if type(record.Character.GetBoundingBox) ~= "function" or not root.CFrame then return "Full observed avatar clearance unavailable" end
		local bodyFrame, bodySize = record.Character:GetBoundingBox()
		if not bodyFrame or not vector(bodySize) or bodySize.X <= 0 or bodySize.Y <= 0 or bodySize.Z <= 0 then
			return "Full observed avatar bounds unavailable"
		end
		local bodyOffset = root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(bodyFrame)
		if not vector(bodyOffset.Position) or not vector(bodyOffset.RightVector) or not vector(bodyOffset.UpVector)
			or not vector(bodyOffset.LookVector) then return "Full avatar/root orientation unavailable" end
		-- Candidate root is upright. Transform the observed full avatar box relative
		-- to that root; include legs/head/accessories rather than only HRP.Size.
		local halfVertical = (math.abs(bodyOffset.RightVector.Y) * bodySize.X + math.abs(bodyOffset.UpVector.Y) * bodySize.Y
			+ math.abs(bodyOffset.LookVector.Y) * bodySize.Z) / 2
		local height = math.max(humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2, halfVertical - bodyOffset.Position.Y) + 0.15
		local ray = RaycastParams.new()
		ray.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		ray.FilterDescendantsInstances = { record.Character }
		ray.RespectCanCollide = true
		local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
		overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		overlap.RespectCanCollide = true
		local radius = math.min(4, record.Range / 2)
		local pos = target.Position
		-- Try the source-associated anchor X/Z first. Visible egg overlap alone is
		-- not collision: only actual CanCollide geometry blocks the avatar volume.
		-- Keep collidable Rendered platforms/egg parts in the floor/clearance query.
		local diagonal = radius / math.sqrt(2)
		for _, offset in ipairs({ Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Vector3.new(radius, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-radius, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, radius), Vector3.new(0, 0, -radius),
			Vector3.new(diagonal, 0, diagonal), Vector3.new(diagonal, 0, -diagonal), Vector3.new(-diagonal, 0, diagonal), Vector3.new(-diagonal, 0, -diagonal) }) do
			local horizontal = pos + offset
			local result = workspace:Raycast(horizontal + Vector3.new(0, record.Range, 0), Vector3.new(0, -record.Range * 2, 0), ray)
			local floor = result and result.Instance
			if live(floor) and floor.CanCollide == true and floor.Anchored == true and vector(result.Position)
				and vector(result.Normal) and result.Normal.Y >= 0.98 then
				local standing = Vector3.new(horizontal.X, result.Position.Y + height, horizontal.Z)
				if (standing - pos).Magnitude <= record.Range - 0.25 and self:RangeEligibleAt(record, standing) then
					local facing = Vector3.new(pos.X - standing.X, 0, pos.Z - standing.Z)
					if facing.Magnitude < 0.05 then
						local observed = root.CFrame.LookVector
						if not vector(observed) then return "Observed avatar facing unavailable at the physical anchor" end
						facing = Vector3.new(observed.X, 0, observed.Z)
						if facing.Magnitude < 0.05 then return "Observed avatar facing has no upright standing direction" end
					end
					local frame = CFrame.lookAt(standing, standing + facing)
					-- A center hit does not prove footprint support. Accept only a
					-- numerically level solid block whose full padded avatar projection
					-- fits its observed top face; other shapes remain unverified.
					local floorFrame, floorSize = floor.CFrame, floor.Size
					local supported = floor:IsA("Part") and floor.Shape == Enum.PartType.Block and floorFrame
						and vector(floorSize) and floorSize.X > 0 and floorSize.Y > 0 and floorSize.Z > 0
						and vector(floorFrame.RightVector) and vector(floorFrame.UpVector) and vector(floorFrame.LookVector)
						and floorFrame.UpVector.Y >= 1 - 1e-6 and math.abs(floorFrame.RightVector.Y) <= 1e-6
						and math.abs(floorFrame.LookVector.Y) <= 1e-6
					if supported then
						local body = frame * bodyOffset
						local half = (bodySize + Vector3.new(0.3, 0.1, 0.3)) * 0.5
						for _, x in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
							for _, y in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
								for _, z in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
									local corner = body.Position + body.RightVector * (x * half.X)
										+ body.UpVector * (y * half.Y) + body.LookVector * (z * half.Z)
									local top = floorFrame:PointToObjectSpace(Vector3.new(corner.X, result.Position.Y, corner.Z))
									if not vector(top) or math.abs(top.Y - floorSize.Y / 2) > 0.01
										or math.abs(top.X) > floorSize.X / 2 - 0.15 or math.abs(top.Z) > floorSize.Z / 2 - 0.15 then
										supported = false
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if not supported then continue end
					overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = { record.Character, floor }
					local blocked = false
					for _, obstacle in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(frame * bodyOffset, bodySize + Vector3.new(0.3, 0.1, 0.3), overlap)) do
						if obstacle.CanCollide == true then blocked = true break end
					end
					if not blocked then return frame end
				end
			end
		end
		return record.LocationOnly and "No supported floor and clear full avatar volume within diagnostic physical radius; manual approach required"
			or "No supported floor and clear full avatar volume within native hatch range; manual approach required"
	end)
	if not ok then return nil, "Standing-geometry observation failed: " .. tostring(frameOrReason) end
	if type(frameOrReason) == "string" then return nil, frameOrReason end
	return frameOrReason
end

function GameMechanics:PositionSelectedEgg(manager, record, frame, token)
	local c = self.LocalFeatureController
	local active = c and c.Scheduler and c.Scheduler.Active
	local function owns()
		return c and c.State == "RUNNING" and manager == c.EggTravel and c.Scheduler.Active == active and active
			and active.Definition.Owner == "EGG_TRAVEL" and active.Definition.Generation == c.Generation and active.Token == token
	end
	if not owns() then return false, "Selected-egg task does not own the scheduler" end
	if not self.Config.EGG_TRAVEL_SETTINGS.ENABLE_DIRECT_POSITIONING then return false, "Direct egg positioning disabled" end
	local fresh, reason = manager:Validate(record, token)
	if not fresh then return false, reason end
	local allowed, blocker = self:LocalFeatureGuard()
	if not allowed then return false, blocker end
	fresh, reason = manager:Validate(record, token)
	if not fresh then return false, reason end
